turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My espresso shots taste really sour, and they come out in like ten seconds.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a classic sign of the grind being too coarse. Water rushes through without pulling out enough flavour.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, a little finer at a time. You're aiming for roughly twenty five to thirty seconds for a standard shot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start baking bread at home and I have a few ways to begin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just listen while I lay them all out, and I'll ask for your view at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a simple no knead loaf that rises overnight and bakes in a heavy pot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is starting a sourdough starter, which takes about a week before I can even bake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could just buy a bread machine that does everything for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The no knead loaf is the easiest place to start, and it tastes amazing for so little effort. Sourdough is really rewarding, but it needs patience and daily feeding. The bread machine is convenient but you learn less.
